ticket: NI03/NI05/NI11/NI12 — trade remedies reach a sector, gated by legal stage
problem: 125 of 181 events classified as `other`, and the largest group among them were US anti-dumping and countervailing determinations naming Indian products — the class that carries a foreign measure and an Indian product in one sentence, and the one the plan asks for as 'at least one complete foreign-policy-to-Indian-sector path'

built.event_class: trade_remedy_determination, ordered ahead of the generic tariff rule because 'anti-dumping' appears in both and a determination is a stage in a proceeding, not a new tariff
built.legal_stage: consultation (initiated) / announced (preliminary) / adopted (final) / effective (order) / expired (sunset) / repealed (revocation) — read from the instrument
built.subject_origin: '<Product> From <Country>:' is the Federal Register's documented title form. The country is the subject origin of the goods, resolved against the curated place registry only, with an evidence span. It is NOT marked `affected`: it seeds a scoped exposure query
built.direction_rule: role-based and stage-gated. Only `adopted` or `effective` establishes a measure; `exporter` is adverse and `domestic_producer` favourable, because the same measure protects the producer competing with the imports it restricts
built.exposure_edge: one cited, UNSIZED edge in -> sector:steel, keyed to trade_remedy_determination and steel product terms, target_role exporter

citations.what_they_support: US duty orders exist on an Indian steel product. NOT a revenue share, NOT a company exposure, NOT a loss — the edge carries no magnitude so none can be derived

defect_found_while_building.what: a PRELIMINARY determination was classified `adopted`, because its title reads 'Preliminary Affirmative Determination ..., Postponement of Final Determination, and Extension of Provisional Measures' and the final-stage rule matched 'Final Determination' inside 'Postponement of Final Determination'
defect_found_while_building.consequence: a false adverse signal for Indian steel: 'no duty yet' read as an imposed duty
defect_found_while_building.fix: preliminary is tested before final, and the final rule is guarded against a preceding postponement / extension / scheduling

'adverse for the exporter' is a qualitative mechanism direction, not a measured effect on any listed company, and not a prediction.

product_scope_correction.found: the first version of this edge matched chromium and graphite electrode, and both produced "adverse for the steel sector"
product_scope_correction.why_wrong: chromium trioxide is a metal-finishing chemical; large-diameter graphite electrodes are a consumable INPUT to electric-arc steelmaking. A US duty on either is a duty on a different Indian industry, not on Indian steel exports
product_scope_correction.after: steel articles only: steel | corrosion-resistant | oil country tubular | rail coupler | forged steel fittings
product_scope_correction.effect: steel sector events fell from 8 to 4; every remaining one is a steel article
